g.text: asks to play the preview of a track
asks for the ISRC of the track
looks the preview up by ISRC
searches by artist and track title
searches by artist and track title
plays the preview and shows the pause button
informs that the preview is unavailable
taps the button while the preview is loading
Only one track plays at a time (30 s).
A candidate is accepted only if title, artist and
duration (within 5 s) match the Spotify track.
The preview stops when it ends or when
the app goes to the background.
